name: Rutherford Appleton Laboratory (ISIS)
notes: Coordinate is campus-precision (the whole RAL/Harwell campus), not a surveyed point for the KARMEN detector hall; no fetched source gives a hall-specific coordinate.

summary.plain: The Rutherford Appleton Laboratory campus near Didcot, Oxfordshire, England, home to the ISIS particle accelerator. The KARMEN neutrino detector sat here, about 18 metres from where ISIS's proton beam struck its target.
summary.technical: STFC Rutherford Appleton Laboratory campus, Harwell Science and Innovation Campus, Didcot, Oxfordshire (postcode OX11 0QX); site of the ISIS pulsed spallation source and, 1990-2001, of the KARMEN liquid-scintillator neutrino detector at a mean distance of 17.7 m from the ISIS target.
